title: 20 Years Ago Today, Shonen Jump’s Darkest Anime Hero Changed the World Forever
content:
There’s no denying that Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump is the biggest manga magazine of all time, known for serializing several classics over the decades. Launched in 1968, the magazine eventually released fan-favorite series such as One Piece, Dragon Ball, Naruto , and many more acclaimed manga. The magazine has seen countless changes over the years, but the biggest one is the transition from long-running series to shorter stories. However, while that trend is new to fans in the 2010s and 2020s, Death Note is one of the shorter stories that somehow made its mark in the industry. Written by Tsugumi Ohba and illustrated by Takeshi Obata, the manga was serialized from 2003 to 2006.

It didn’t take long after the manga finale for Madhouse to release an anime adaptation, forever changing the Shonen industry. The anime premiered on October 4th, 2026, exactly two decades ago, but even after all this time, it wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say Death Note is one of the best series in anime history, filled with thriller, suspense, and supernatural elements. While the overall story in general is one-of-a-kind, what truly drew fans in is the exceptional main character, Light Yagami, who redefined what a Shonen protagonist could be .

Death Note Follows the Story of a Hero Turned Villain

The story centers around a genius high school student, Light Yagami, who becomes twisted after tasting the kind of power no mortal should’ve known about. While looking out from his classroom window, he saw a seemingly ordinary notebook falling from the sky. He later picked it up and realized it was a Death Note that claims to take the life of a person whose name is written on it if the user fulfills specific conditions, which are quite easy to follow. Although Light believes that the notebook is nothing but a prank, he still decides to experiment with it by using a felon’s name. He never expected he would succeed in killing the criminal, and it doesn’t take long for the teenager to form his own distorted sense of justice and decide to purge the world of all criminals by going on a murder spree.

Going under the alias “Kira,” Light evokes fear and unrest among the people until a mysterious detective known as L swears to stop Kira’s rampage. It also doesn’t help that the true owner of the notebook, Ryuk, a Shinigami, tries to use Light as a means of entertainment. What truly sets him apart is that he begins using the Death Note with a noble intention of ridding the world of criminals. However, the power he possessed in his hand was never something a mortal could handle. To be able to control life and death itself gave him the idea that the kind of a god complex that turned his sense of justice into something twisted.

Death Note Blurs the Line Between Good and Evil

In the process of getting rid of all the criminals in the world, Light never hesitated to use those around him . His goal was to create a peaceful utopia with no crime, but his dream was never fully realized since he became the one causing the chaos he once despised. He manipulated Kisa, who was clearly in love with him. Not to mention that he killed L and his father in hopes of hiding his identity. Light would also never hesitate to erase his memories and manipulate himself if the situation deemed it necessary. He wasn’t born evil, but the power he held turned him into something he couldn’t recognize anymore. In the end, he died a sad death at the hands of the Shinigami who had been using him all that time.

However, it’s not just Light, but the anime in general follows morally gray characters, which makes them all the more intriguing. Instead of painting everything as black or white, the story focuses on the complex characters and the nuance between every step they take. This haunting narrative doesn’t preach a simple lesson, but instead, it tests the viewers by showing a world where a person who lowers global crime rates forces the masses to question if the ends can ever justify the means. The story was never about justice but the lengths someone would go to justify their evil. Instead of a clash between good and evil, the story focuses on a battle of wits between morally gray characters where neither side is completely right or wrong.

Is Death Note one of your favorite anime as well? Let me know in the comments section what you like most about Light Yagami. Or you can just share your favorite Endgame moment to commemorate the anime’s anniversary.

title: 10 Best Anime to Watch on Netflix in October 2026
content:
The Fall 2026 anime season is finally here as fans are already set to welcome the new shows. It’s the final quarter of the year, and it’s going to be the biggest one thanks to the return of major shows such as The Apothecary Diaries, Black Clover , and more. Just like every other season, Netflix will be expanding its library with newer shows for fans in the U.S. As the largest streaming platform in the world, Netflix has been venturing into the anime industry for the past few years. There’s no doubt that when it comes to anime, Netflix’s library isn’t nearly as expansive as Crunchyroll’s.

However, the streaming giant focuses on more unique and original shows and films rather than having a bunch of anime that the viewers wouldn’t want to watch. Since the Fall 2026 season has only just begun, the platform has already shared a lineup for this month . However, the lineup isn’t that expansive, and some of them will be releasing weekly episodes, which isn’t ideal for those who want to binge. With the start of a new month, a brand new watchlist is just as necessary if you want to unwind during the breaks, especially the weekends. These anime series and movies will be perfect for you to watch this October.

10) My Happy Marriage

October is an exciting month for My Happy Marriage fans since the anime is returning with three special episodes. Although there hasn’t been a confirmation for a third season yet, these special episodes are more than enough to keep fans intrigued for a while. All three special episodes will land on the platform on October 25th, but before that, you can catch up with the first two seasons. The first season premiered in July 2023, and it immediately became a fan favorite thanks to its gorgeous animation, captivating story, and intriguing characters.

However, the story in Season 2 gets even more intense as it focuses on Miyo, who comes to terms with her identity as a Usuba and the Dream Sight Maiden. Not only has she gained more confidence thanks to the support of those around her, but she’s also able to use her ability quite well. The latest season was a roller coaster of emotions, with the couple facing several challenges as they find themselves in the middle of politics and power struggles

9) Blue Box

Blue Box is yet another beloved series that returned this month with a second season. While the anime sequel premiered on October 4th, it will only release weekly episodes. The new season has only just premiered, and it’s already generating quite a lot of hype on social media. While fans await more episodes from the series, it’s the perfect time to catch up with the first season, which became a fan-favorite show after its premiere in October 2024. Written and illustrated by Kouji Miura, the anime quickly captured fans’ hearts with its engaging blend of sports and romance and beautiful animation.

The story follows first-year Taiki Inomata, who rushes to his high school gym every morning to catch a glimpse of his crush, Chinatsu Kano. She is a second-year student and already a star player on the girls’ basketball team, which is all the more reason Taiki believes she’s way out of his league. While he was only happy to see her every day from a distance, things begin to change when Chinatsu moves into his house temporarily after her parents move overseas for work.

8) Cyberpunk: Edgerunners

After making fans wait for four years, this sci-fi hit is all set to return with a new season on October 20th . While there are still a few days before the anime releases new episodes, you can catch up with the first season on Netflix. After a successful debut, the story will continue to explore the animated world of Night City. We can also expect the series to flesh out the universe that first started with CD Projekt Red’s video game, Cyberpunk 2077 . Although the first season had a fairly conclusive ending, fans can expect the story to head towards a new direction in the sequel.

Additionally, the anime won’t only focus on Night City’s residents and this futuristic setting, but the Edgerunner class will make a return. Instead of centering around David, an aspiring Edgerunner, the second season focuses on a character named Weak Kingsley, who has long since become a legend of Night City. Weak has been living mostly without the technology that brought him to the top of the food chain. Furthermore, the trailer teases that he will be dragged back into the world he once left behind, leading many to wonder if he’ll face the same tragic ending that David experienced in season one.

7) Perfect Blue

Almost three decades after its original release, Netflix finally licensed this classic last month. Among the critically acclaimed anime of the 1990s, Perfect Blue maintained its legacy for decades and remains one of the most captivating psychological thrillers of all time. The movie is directed by Satoshi Kon, a legendary director known for several timeless classics such as Paprika, Tokyo Godfathers , and many more. Produced under the banner of the renowned studio Madhouse, Perfect Blue has stayed in the spotlight throughout these years thanks to several re-releases, a 4k remastered version, and many more surprises.

This psychological horror was Satoshi Kon’s directorial debut, and the stunning film made him into one of the most renowned filmmakers of all time. The movie blurs the line between reality and fantasy, all the while depicting some of the most spectacular visuals seen in anime history. The story centers around Mima Kirigoe, who switched her career from a J-pop idol to an actress. Her life took a drastic turn after that as she finds herself being targeted by an obsessed fan who begins stalking and impersonating her, leading to all kinds of strange incidents around her, forcing her to question her own sanity.

6) The Ribbon Hero

The Ribbon Hero is an original movie which premiered on the platform this year. If you haven’t already watched this stunning movie yet, it’s not too late to experience it in all its glory. While the story is based on an original script from the studio, the movie is heavily inspired by Osamu Tezuka’s forgotten 1960s classic, Princess Knight . The story by Tezuka takes place in a medieval setting as it centers around Sapphire, a young princess who has no choice but to pretend to be a male prince so she can inherit the throne. This new anime follows a protagonist with the same name, but the story is a much darker version than Tezuka’s manga.

She grieves the loss of her homeland, Silverland, which was destroyed by a calamity called Nergal. The calamity was so devastating that she had no choice but to find temporary shelter with the people of Goldland. Unfortunately, it doesn’t take long for her to realize that the malevolent Nergal refuses to let her people live in peace. Now that her new home is being threatened, the Princess has no choice but to take up arms, wipe away her tears, and fight to protect the new home she found.

5) Sparks of Tomorrow

Although fans await confirmation on the anime’s second season, the first has already wrapped, which means you can finally binge all episodes of this stunning anime. Sparks of Tomorrow was one of the biggest fantasies of Summer 2026, and it caused even more hype since it was being produced by Kyoto Animation. The visuals were some of the best seen in modern anime thanks to the excellent staff, including director Minaru Ota, who has contributed to the acclaimed films A Silent Voice, Violet Evergarden, Liz and the Blue Bird, among many other films and series. The anime is based on the acclaimed light novel written by Hiro Yuki and illustrated by Kazumi Ikeda.

The story is set in an alternate version of early 20th-century Japan, where Kyoto evolved differently from the world we are familiar with. Since the fathers of the modern age of electricity died before they could mark their names in history, Kyoto entered an era of steam power. The story follows Kihachi Sakamoto, who mourns the failed promise he made with his brother. However, he begins to work on his dream once again after a chance encounter with Inaoko Momonkawa, as she encourages him to unravel the secrets behind the electrical catalog.

4) Dorohedoro

Since Halloween is right around the corner, Dorohedoro is one of the best anime that fans can watch this spooky season . Produced by MAPPA, this dark fantasy series finally received the popularity it deserved after its second season was released this year. While the third season is currently under production, both seasons of the anime are streaming on Netflix. The anime premiered in 2020, and it took the animation studio six years to release a second season. However, the wait was more than worth it thanks to the exceptional story and stunning visuals, which MAPPA is famous for. The story follows Caiman, a half-reptile, half-man, who is a victim of brutal experiments by sorcerers, as he is cursed with his appearance and tormented by nightmares.

He has no memories of his past, which makes it all the more difficult for him to catch the perpetrators responsible for his condition. Accompanied by his female companion, Nikaido, Caiman discovers the dark secrets lingering in the alleys of the Hole while also uncovering what truly transpired in the past. While the anime hasn’t shared a release window for Season 3, it shouldn’t take long considering fans already got a glimpse at the sequel.

3) Death Note

Speaking of spooky season, Death Note is another major anime that would be perfect to binge this month. Not to mention that the anime is commemorating its 20th anniversary this month, which is all the more reason why it’s currently in the spotlight. It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say Death Note is one of the best series in anime history, filled with thriller, suspense, and supernatural elements. The series follows morally gray characters in a battle of wits as the identity of Kira becomes a force that ties them all together. The story centers around Light Yagami, a genius high school student, who becomes twisted after tasting the kind of power no mortal should’ve known about.

Although Light believes that the Death Note he picked up from the ground is nothing but a prank, he still decides to experiment with it by using a random felon’s name. However, Light never expected he would succeed in killing the criminal. It doesn’t take long for the teenager to form his own distorted sense of twisted justice and decide to purge the world of all criminals by going on a murder spree. Going under the alias “Kira,” Light evokes fear and unrest among the people until a mysterious detective known as L swears to stop his rampage.

2) Dandadan

While the wait for Dandadan Season 3 is longer than expected, you can enjoy the first two seasons on Netflix. Right after its debut, the anime captured viewers’ hearts with its eccentric story, lovable characters, and breathtaking animation. The impressive adaptation by Science SARU is widely praised as one of the best in recent years, not only for its animation style but also for its pacing, voice acting, OSTs, and the way it perfectly translates the manga’s emotions into a new medium. No doubt Season 3 will be even more exciting with another set of impressive episodes. The third season will be out in 2027, but it’s going to be worth the wait since the anime is adapting the manga’s best arc.

Not only that, but Dandadan is yet another incredible anime fans can watch this spooky season, as it features yokai and aliens while the main characters get entangled in all kinds of dangerous situations. This supernatural action ended its latest season on a major cliffhanger, leaving several questions unanswered after the introduction of a mysterious character . Compared to the previous seasons, the upcoming season is going to be far more intense and action-packed, with a lot of exciting plot twists.

1) Demon Slayer: Infinity Castle Movie

While fans are still awaiting updates on the upcoming sequel of the movie, Netflix began streaming the first installment on September 28th, 2026. The movie hit the Japanese theatres in July last year before making its international debut in September 2025. It became the highest-grossing anime movie of all time, which is all the more reason why fans had to wait longer than expected since the movie was running in the theatres for several months. Regardless, the movie finally hit the streaming platforms more than a year later, and it’s about time fans get to rewatch the stunning animation by Ufotable. The movie features the Infinity Castle Arc, where the Demon Slayers were trapped inside an endless labyrinth.

The Corps members already have their hands full with all the demons waiting to kill them inside the castle, but they also ned to track down Muzan Kibutsuji. The latest movie follows the beginning of the tragic, night-long battle as the Corps members fight to end the terror of the demons. The first movie follows three battles highlighting the exceptional skills of Zenitsu, Shinobu, Tanjiro, and Giyu. However, the arc is far from over, and the upcoming movies will feature even more intense battles against the Upper Moons.

Do you agree with our picks – or have an anime in mind that you want to add here? Share your recommendations in the comments.

title: Manhwa-Based Live-Action Series The Blue Road Set to Premiere on November 20
content:
Netflix announced on Friday the manhwa -based live-action series The Blue Road , previously known as the working title "Road," will premiere on November 20.

Directed by Joon-hee Han, who previously helmed D.P. and Coin Locker Girl , the series follows two detectives investigating a string of murders that crosses the border between South Korea and Japan. The two detectives have different investigative methods and personalities as they pursue the connected murders across Korea and Japan.

Seok-gu Son stars as Seok Kim, a detective with the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency, while Eita Nagayama plays Inose, a detective with the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department.

Netflix has also released the series' first poster and trailer. The poster features Son and Nagayama standing in back alleys in Korea and Japan, with mysterious messages written in Korean and Japanese appearing behind them.

The trailer introduces crime scenes, messages written in the victims' blood, a Korean-Japanese businessman played by Shin-rok Kim, and a mysterious tiger drawing. It also teases growing tension between the two detectives.

The live-action adaptation is based on the 2002 Korean-Japanese collaborative comic Purungil – Ao no Michi (Blue Road), written by Keishi Edogawa and drawn by Korean artist Kaya Kwon. The five-volume series blended hard-boiled crime storytelling with themes of cultural tension and cross-border cooperation, making it a distinctive work of its time.

The manhwa follows the investigation of a gruesome cross-border serial murder case. The story begins in Tokyo, where authorities discover a twisted, contorted corpse accompanied by a blood-written message in Korean. Shortly afterward, a similar crime scene emerges in South Korea—this time with a Japanese message written near the victim. The shocking parallels force law enforcement in both countries to recognize the crimes as linked, leading two detectives, one Korean and one Japanese, to join forces in pursuit of the killer.

title: 12 Years Ago, This Classic Shonen Jump Anime Ended With No Chance of Return
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Hunter x Hunter manga! There’s no denying that Weekly Shonen Jump is the best manga magazine of all time as it has serialized some of the greatest series in history. Whether its Dragon Ball or Naruto , most of the iconic series made their mark in history after being serialized in the magazine. Among the beloved classics, one of them is Hunter x Hunter , which began serialization in March 1998. However, only a few years after the manga’s debut, it began facing frequent hiatuses due to Togashi’s health issues. The creator has been dealing with chronic health and severe back issues for more than 20 years while also working on the manga.

For several years, Shueisha has been accommodating Togashi with his schedule , supporting his decision to work at his own pace instead of following any kind of weekly or even quarterly schedule. This is exactly why the manga didn’t change. Regardless, the manga’s irregular schedule also caused the anime to face several issues since the original series from 1999 was discontinued only after 64 episodes. Produced by Nippon Animation, it featured the fan-favorite grainy visuals that breathed life into the incredible story by Togashi. However, after the original anime was discontinued in 2001, fans waited a decade for the reboot, which also faced the same consequences.

Hunter x Hunter Ended Its Reboot 12 Years Ago

The reboot debuted in 2011 with more polished visuals and a faithful adaptation than the original. Not to mention that with Madhouse producing the reboot, the hype was already bigger than ever. Madhouse is one of the most renowned studios in Japan, known for several timeless classics such as Monster, Death Note , and more. The studio was established in 1972, and it’s still going strong thanks to all the exceptional series. Madhouse didn’t disappoint with the reboot either, but it didn’t manage to continue the story for long after the 13th Hunter Chairman Election Arc. The anime had caught up with the manga by that time, and it had no choice but to wrap up on September 24th, 2014.

The manga moved on to the Succession Contest Arc , which has been ongoing for over a decade. Even after the anime’s success and incredible adaptation, there hasn’t been any confirmation of its return for 12 years now because of the manga’s unusual schedule. There’s also a possibility that Madhouse might never return with a sequel for the reboot since it has already been a long time and the studio hasn’t so much as dropped a hint of continuing the series. While the Succession Contest Arc is still ongoing, it has released around 80 chapters by now , which is more than enough for one season with two cours. While the anime’s future looks bleak, the manga continues to shock fans with its best arc ever.

The Succession Contest Arc Has Been Ongoing Since 2012

The Succession Contest Arc kicked off with Chapter 340, which was originally released in March 2012. Due to the frequent indefinite hiatuses, the arc is still ongoing. It’s one of the best arcs in the story as it puts Kurapika in the middle of the action . Kurapika has always been a fan-favorite character, and it was about time the series gave him the much-needed spotlight. The manga follows him when he gets entangled with the royal family of the Kakin Empire. The battle for the crown has begun, and the winner will be the sole survivor in a deathmatch among the 14 princes of the Empire. Kurapika takes on the job of protecting the 9th prince, but he’s disappointed to find out he has to protect the youngest prince of the Kingdom.

However, he still carries on with the job since his true objective is to recover the last remaining scarlet eyes of his clan from the 4th prince. The story has featured several exciting plot twists so far, and it’s already the second-longest arc in the series. The manga released new chapters this year while Togashi is working diligently on his return. Instead of following a regular schedule, HxH returns every once in a while to release at least 10 chapters on a weekly schedule before going on a hiatus again. Considering the pace of Togashi’s work and his regular updates on X, we can expect the manga to return next year with ten more chapters.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the anime to return, or should it get a brand new adaptation instead? Or you could tell us your favorite D.Gray-man moment.

title: Dandadan Returns With Special New Look Ahead of Season 3
content:
DAN DA DAN is one of the many anime that fans are excited to see make its return with new episodes next year, and the wait is getting even tougher with a special new look helping to commemorate the Fall season. Yukinobu Tatsu’s DAN DA DAN was already one of the breakout successes from Shueisha’s Jump+ app , and it’s become an even more popular franchise thanks to the success of the anime’s first two seasons. But unfortunately, there’s just a bit more of a wait for the next season.

DAN DA DAN has a much wider gap for its third season than there had been seen with the first two seasons of the TV anime series, but there’s a way to help ease that wait with a special new poster released for the Fall season. Sharing a fun new look at Momo and the others ( though the anime’s official social media ) as they enjoy a great Fall evening, it’s a fun way to get reacquainted with the fan favorites ahead of the upcoming third season. Check it out below.

When Does DAN DA DAN Season 3 Come Out?

DAN DA DAN Season 3 is now in the works for a release sometime in 2027 , but has yet to confirm a more concrete release date or window as of the time of this writing. Science SARU will also be returning to oversee animation production on the new season, but any actual members of the production staff have yet to be revealed. It’s also likely that the voice cast for the anime will be reprising their respective roles for the new season, but treat that all as unconfirmed for now until it’s officially stated.

DAN DA DAN will hopefully be sharing much more about the coming season soon as it has also been announced to join the slate of titles with something to showcase during Shueisha’s Jump Festa 2027 event later this year . Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend in Japan, this annual event is where Shueisha shares updates on their biggest franchises and it’s likely where we’ll get a concrete update on the now in the works third season. Hopefully it’s even a full teaser or trailer.

What’s Going on in DAN DA DAN Season 3?

The wait for this third season of DAN DA DAN has been even tougher considering that the second season ended off on a huge cliffhanger for the future. Okarun and Momo had to contend with a giant alien kaiju in the final episodes, and the final moments of the finale saw a strange girl inside of the kaiju come out and embrace Okarun . That seemed to spark something within Momo upon seeing it, but we won’t see the fallout in action until this third season.

If you wanted to check out the anime and catch up with everything that has happened so far, you can find DAN DA DAN now streaming on multiple platforms such as Netflix, Hulu, Hulu on Disney+ and Crunchyroll. And you’re going to want to do so considering that it’s only going to get much wilder from here on out. But are you excited for DAN DA DAN Season 3? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: WEBTOON's The Mafia Nanny Gets Live-Action Series Adaptation at Hulu
content:
According to entertainment news outlet Deadline on September 17, Hulu is developing a live-action series adaptation of WEBTOON 's popular action romance webcomic The Mafia Nanny , with Charlize Theron serving as an executive producer.

Violet Matter is the webcomic's writer, and sh00 is drawing the art with assistance by roousuu and Drawniels. The story of The Mafia Nanny reads:

Being an Elite Nanny is simple: protect the charge, obey the principle, and don't get emotionally attached. Easier said than done when Davina's first client is a dangerously compelling Venetian underboss who's determined to get under her skin. What he wants from her, she can't imagine, but Gabriel Angelini drags her back into the glittering world of organized crime she thought she'd left behind forever. She might get answers about her past if she digs deep enough, but can she protect Mikey from his father's ambitions and keep her heart from getting tangled up in their treacherous web?

The webcomic had been nominated for Best Webcomic at the Ringo Awards and Digital Book of the Year at the Harvey Awards last year. The webcomic was also nominated for Best Webcomic again this year at the Ringo Awards.

The Mafia Nanny , one of the most successful English-language webtoons, has accumulated more than 420 million views globally.

Max Gill is an executive producer and will write the television adaptation, and 20th Television, Secret Menu, WEBTOON Productions, and Steady Collective will produce it. Other executive producers include Beth Kono, AJ Dix, and Matt Maher for Secret Menu; David Madden and Sera Tabb for WEBTOON Productions; and Dawn Olmstead for Steady Collective.

Deadline stated the project is believed to the first English-language live-action series adaptation of a WEBTOON IP.

Fans can read the webcomic on WEBTOON .

title: 3 Years Later, Major Fantasy Reboot Drops First Look Trailer for Season 2 Return – Watch
content:
A major fantasy series is coming back to screens with a new season of its official reboot series, and fans have gotten the first full look at its comeback with a new trailer showing it all off. While the Fall 2026 anime schedule has ushered in a new wave of releases that fans are undoubtedly going to be obsessed with over the next few months, there’s an even bigger wave of new releases coming to our screen next year. 2027 is teasing some big names coming our way, and that includes a big reboot’s return.

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf is an official reboot anime series adapting Isuna Hasekura and Ju Ayakura’s light novels from the very beginning, and it’s gearing up to cover all sorts of ground that hasn’t been seen in the classic TV anime series from a decade ago . Making its return with a second season sometime next year, Spice and Wolf’ s reboot series has dropped a new trailer you can check out in action below.

Spice and Wolf Reboot Season 2 Confirms 2027 Release With New Trailer

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf Season 2 is currently scheduled for a release sometime in 2027 , but it has yet to confirm a more concrete release date as of the time of this writing. If you liked the first season of the reboot then you’re in luck as the second season will bring back the production staff from the first season with Takeo Takashi serving as chief director, and Nobuyoshi Nagayama and Takahiro Majima directing the new episodes for studio Passione.

Koji Haneda and Rina Sugimoto are also slated to return to handle the character designs, and Kevin Penkin is returning to compose the music. The voice cast is all set to return to reprise their respective roles as well, and it’s even more impressive considering that they all returned from the first TV anime adaptation ten years prior with Jun Fukuyama as Kraft Lawrence, Ami Koshimizu as Holo, and Mai Nakahara as Norah Arendt. A new addition to the voice cast has been revealed with this new trailer too as Romi Park joins the cast as Eve Bolan.

What’s Next for Spice & Wolf’s New Reboot?

The first season of Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf has already done quite a lot to impress fans as it covered some materials that had been previously skipped over by the first TV anime adaptation in the 2010s . The reboot is also touting that it will be a much more complete experience than seen with the anime the first time around, so that’s yet another reason why this upcoming season is all the more intriguing as it teases some brand new ground not seen before.

Spice & Wolf: merchant meets the wise wolf is also going to be counting down towards its second season debut with a special promotional train that was seen the first time around. The anime will be releasing a special poster for the reboot series on a monthly basis to celebrate each new passing season, and the first (which you can check out above) gives Holo a Halloween makeover. But what are you hoping to see from the Spice and Wolf reboot’s return? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Confirms Episode Count After Premiere
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is finally back in action with its highly anticipated third season, and a new update has revealed how many episodes it’s planning to stick around for. The Apothecary Diaries is leading off the new wave of returning franchises coming back for more episodes as part of the Fall 2026 anime schedule, and with it fans are being treated to a welcome return from Maomao as she’s on the cusp of starting out a brand new mystery. But there’s still much more to explore.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has made its premiere, and the first episode of the new season has already been a big hit with fans thus fa r. While it’s only further setting the groundwork of what next to expect from the rest of the season, fans are already eager to see where it’s all going. Thankfully this season is going to have the same total number of episodes as the anime had for its first two seasons as revealed on its official website.

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Reveals How Many Episodes It Will Last For

The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has confirmed it will be running for 24 episodes, much like the first two seasons. Spread over four Blu-ray/DVD volumes hitting shelves in Japan, this third season will be broken into two cours. The first cour of the series will be airing its new episodes through the Fall, then the anime will be taking a break for a few months before returning for its second cour of episodes sometime next April as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. So there’s quite a lot coming in the future for the anime.

If you wanted to catch the new episodes as they air in Japan, you can now find The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 streaming with Crunchyroll Crunchyroll in North America, Central America, South America, Europe, Africa, Oceania, the Middle East, CIS and Indian Subcontinent ( along with being available for Netflix only in select regions of Asia ). With a big mystery at play as a new famine seems to be on the horizon, there might be a mystery that even Maomao won’t be able to solve before it’s all said and done. That makes it all the more intriguing.

What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries?

The Apothecary Diaries has become such a massive franchise over the last few years that the third season is far from everything that’s set to make its debut this year. Coming to theaters in Japan later December is a feature film debut for the franchise, but international release plans for it have yet to be revealed as of this time. The Apothecary Diaries: The Movie is going to cover a story not seen in the light novels or anime releases, and you can actually check out the first trailer for it in the video above.

That’s not all that’s in the works for the franchise’s immediate future either. The Apothecary Diaries is also in the works on a new live-action series with Prime Video (that already has the creator’s seal of approval ), and even a new video game release. There’s something for every kind of fan coming, so are you excited for the future of The Apothecary Diaries ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

With a big mystery at play as a new famine seems to be on the horizon, there might be a mystery that even Maomao won’t be able to solve before it’s all said and done. That makes it all the more intriguing.
What’s Next for The Apothecary Diaries?

The Apothecary Diaries has become such a massive franchise over the last few years that the third season is far from everything that’s set to make its debut this year. Coming to theaters in Japan later December is a feature film debut for the franchise, but international release plans for it have yet to be revealed as of this time. The Apothecary Diaries: The Movie is going to cover a story not seen in the light novels or anime releases, and you can actually check out the first trailer for it in the video above.

That’s not all that’s in the works for the franchise’s immediate future either. The Apothecary Diaries is also in the works on a new live-action series with Prime Video (that already has the creator’s seal of approval ), and even a new video game release. There’s something for every kind of fan coming, so are you excited for the future of The Apothecary Diaries ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Shonen Jump Teases Updates for Its Biggest Hits With New Livestream Coming Soon
content:
Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine is about to share some new updates soon, and has revealed a new livestream teasing some of its biggest hits coming our way this month. Shonen Jump fans are in for quite a treat through the rest of the year as there are still a number of major events with plans to share updates for some of the new franchise projects now in the works. But even with events like Jump Festa 2027 slated for later in the year, Shueisha is still planning some other new updates soon enough.

Shueisha has officially set a date for its next Jump Press livestream event as it’s set to make its debut on YouTube on October 12th. This event is teasing it will be featuring updates from some key franchises like Haikyu!!, Kagurabachi , and Black Clover , and it’s certainly something to keep an eye out for as there could also be a major anime adaptation announcement that fans have been eagerly anticipating. You can check out the announcement graphic for the livestream below.

Jump Press Teases Nue’s Exorcist Anime Update

Jump Press could end up being something much bigger than fans could have expected. The last major stream of this kind came earlier this Spring where it was first announced that Takeru Hokazono’s Kagurabachi would be getting an official TV anime adaptation of its own. This next event teases a new update for Kagurabachi as well alongside Haikyu!!, Black Clover and Mashle: Magic and Muscles , all franchises that now have a new anime adaptation in the works. That’s what makes Nue’s Exorcist included in the teased franchises all the more interesting for the event.

Kota Kawae’s Nue’s Exorcist has been running in Shonen Jump for about as much time as Kagurabachi has over the last few years, but it’s no closer to getting recognized with its own anime adaptation. Things started to move in a good direction when it was revealed that a website domain had been registered for the series , and that’s the same thing that happened shortly before the Kagurabachi anime was announced during the Jump Press seen earlier this Spring. So make sure to keep an eye out for this livestream just in case the next big Shonen Jump anime gets announced.

What’s Next for Shonen Jump?

Shonen Jump still has a packed year as not only are there going to be multiple chapters of each series hitting the magazine each week, but there are also plans to share updates about all of the new projects each of these franchises have in the works. Events like New York Comic Con have already staked their claims with new updates planned for Naruto and Dragon Ball Super , but there’s even more coming our way during the next Jump Festa event hitting this December.

If Nue’s Exorcist does confirm a new anime adaptation during this streaming event, we could see a much bigger update during Jump Festa 2027. Taking place over the December 19-20 weekend in Japan , this annual event shares new updates for all of Shonen Jump’s big franchises and we could see even more for the anime after this livestream. What are you hoping to see from this Jump Press livestream? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Web Novel-Based Live-Action Series Take Charge of My Heart Unveils Main Trailer
content:
The web novel-based live-action Korean series Take Charge of My Heart released its main trailer on September 28, ahead of its October 9 premiere.

Based on the web novel of the same name, Take Charge of My Heart is a romantic comedy about Ho-rang Baek (Young-kwang Kim), a third-generation chaebol executive whose artificial heart battery is running out; and Bo-bae Na (Su-bin Chae), a drama writer who gained the ability to generate electricity after being struck by lightning as a child.

Bo-bae discovers that her electric ability has no effect on Ho-rang, while Ho-rang discovers that staying near her can recharge his artificial heart battery. The two eventually enter into a three-month contract involving physical contact so that Bo-bae can help keep Ho-rang's battery charged before his next surgery.

The newly released trailer follows Bo-bae as she meets Ho-rang, the only person immune to her electrical powers. After discovering that his battery recharges around her, Ho-rang proposes a three-month contract to stay together, saying he needs her help to survive.

Bo-bae, a drama writer who has never experienced a proper romance because of her powers, accepts the arrangement as she works on a "romance bucket list" for her latest script. Their unusual relationship becomes more complicated with the arrival of top star Eun-ho, Bo-bae's No. 1 fan, setting up a love triangle.

Currently, an official English version of the web novel is not available. Haebeon originally serialized the story on Naver Series.
